_doc: Locale pack. Every pack must carry the same keys as en.json; scripts/check_locales.py enforces that. Structural chrome only — analytical prose is written by the agent in this language.

cover.subtitle_default: Talent economics reconstructed from public data
cover.method_note: Method: every figure is tagged Disclosed / Derived / Inferred / Assumption. TC = base salary + expected cash bonus or commission + annualised vested equity value, pre-tax. Interval estimates are preferred over false-precision point estimates.

executive: Scale, the upper tail of pay, and the uncertainty that matters most.
charter: Separate economic ownership, voting power, board control and legacy rights. Reconstructed terms must never pose as original charter text.
business: Before pricing anyone, establish where profit is created and who controls it.
talent_pnl: Which roles actually control revenue, margin, customer relationships and technical bottlenecks. Dependency is graded qualitatively only.
organization: Keep company-native titles and levels; build a separate latent state that is comparable across companies.
compensation: Model base, cash bonus and annualised vested equity separately, then aggregate to annual pre-tax TC.
high_compensation: Use a Monte Carlo interval for the number of employees above the threshold, never a point estimate.
role_pay: Market replacement cost is only the starting point; economic justification and internal equity define the defensible zone.
career: Public profiles support observed transition shares, which are not the company's true promotion probabilities.
governance: How much ownership goes to whom is the company's own strongest statement about which roles are critical.
sensitivity: Which assumptions would most change the headcount and pricing conclusions, and which missing evidence would narrow the intervals fastest.
evidence: The report keeps core evidence only; the full source manifest and claim ledger travel with the audit bundle.

labels.first_threshold_state: State that first crosses the threshold
labels.senior_hire_mix: Senior roles: internal build vs external buy
labels.provisional_note: Provisional: {facts} was not publicly available. This estimate rests on modelled assumptions and must be read as a range, not a measurement.

threshold_sentence: Annual pre-tax TC >= {amount} {currency} (base + cash bonus + annualised vested equity; equity priced on a {basis} basis)
